article_content: Kwa mara ya kwanza, Angola imepata nafasi kuwa mwenyeji wa mkutano wa OPEC, ikitajwa kuwa na ongezeko la utajiri wa mafuta kuliko nchi yoyote Afrika, ingawa baadhi ya wataalamu wanasema mafanikio haya hayataendelea kwa muda mrefu. Wengi wa mawaziri wa OPEC wamepongeza bei ya mafuta sasa ya takriban dola 75 kwa pipa kama nzuri sana, ingawa wengine wanahoji kwamba ni zaidi ya inavyohitajika na inachangia gharama za maisha kupanda. Wachambuzi wanaonya mkutano wa Luanda unaweza kubadili muelekeo wa sekta ya mafuta duniani, hasa ikiwa Iraq itaongeza uzalishaji wake mara tatu tofauti na mpango wa awali, jambo linaloweza kupunguza umuhimu wa baadhi ya viongozi wa OPEC na kuvuruga soko. Ripoti zingine zinasema Iraq tayari imeshazidi viwango, na hili limezua sintofahamu na mivutano na nchi kama Saudi Arabia. Waziri wa mafuta wa Iraq, Hussein al-Shahristani, akiwa na hofu na wasiwasi wa jibu la jamii ya kimataifa, alikataa kabisa kuzungumzia viwango vya Iraq, akisema bado hali tete kwa sababu ya hatari mpya za mashambulizi ya kigaidi kwenye visima vya mafuta. Ripoti zisizothibitishwa zinadai Iraq haijawahi kufuata viwango vya OPEC tangu mwanzo wa uanachama wake na huenda isilazimishwe hata siku za baadaye. Waziri wa Mafuta wa Angola, Jose Botelho de Vasconcelos, alianza kwa msisitizo mkubwa kutetea kwamba viwango vitabakia kama ilivyo, ingawa wachambuzi wangine wanasema Angola ndiye muanzilishi wa kuvunja viwango mara kwa mara. Mwezi wa Januari, OPEC ilitangaza kwa nguvu zote kupunguza uzalishaji kwa mapipa milioni 4.2 kwa siku, hatua ambayo wengine wanadai ilikuwa zaidi ya kisiasa na haikuleta mabadiliko makubwa yaliyotarajiwa. Katika mkutano huu wa Luanda, mada kuu ni kwamba karibu nusu ya wanachama wa OPEC sasa wanauza mafuta nje ya viwango vilivyokubaliwa, na wachumi wanahofia hii inaweza kuleta kuporomoka kwa ghafla kwa bei na kuathiri uchumi wa dunia. Waziri wa Mafuta wa Umoja wa Falme za Kiarabu, Mohammed bin Dhaen al-Hamli, ameonya waziwazi kuwa kutovaa viwango ni kama usaliti kwa OPEC na sasa kuna mjadala mkali kuhusu hatua za kinidhamu ndani ya mkutano. Angola, licha ya kuwa mwenyeji, imelaumiwa zaidi kwa kupindukia viwango, na ripoti zisizothibitishwa zinadai huenda Angola imewashawishi wanachama wengine kufanya hivyo. Iran na Nigeria pia wametajwa, ingawa viongozi wao wamekanusha hayo kabisa. Saudi Arabia, licha ya kupunguza uzalishaji, imekumbwa na shinikizo kutoka kwa wabunge wa ndani wakidai hatua hizi zinapunguza mapato na kuhatarisha uchumi wa taifa.
translated_content: For the first time, Angola is hosting the OPEC meeting and is being described as having a surge in oil wealth surpassing any other African country, although some experts caution that these successes may not last. Many OPEC ministers have praised the current oil price of around $75 per barrel as excellent, while others argue that it exceeds what's necessary and contributes to higher living costs. Analysts warn the Luanda meeting could shift the direction of the global oil sector, especially if Iraq boosts output threefold over initial plans—a move that could diminish some OPEC leaders’ influence and disrupt markets. Other reports claim Iraq has already exceeded quotas, heating up tensions and confusion with countries like Saudi Arabia. Iraq's Oil Minister, Hussein al-Shahristani, fearful and concerned about the international community's response, completely refused to discuss quotas, stating the situation remains unstable due to new terrorist threats targeting oil wells. Unconfirmed reports allege Iraq has never adhered to OPEC quotas since joining and may not be forced to do so in the future. Angola’s Oil Minister Jose Botelho de Vasconcelos made a strong case that quotas will remain unchanged, but other analysts maintain Angola is the chief violator of quotas repeatedly. In January, OPEC announced with much fanfare it would reduce production by 4.2 million barrels daily, a move that some label as more political than economic and ineffective in delivering the major changes expected. A key issue at Luanda is that nearly half of OPEC members are now selling oil beyond agreed quotas, with economists fearing this could trigger a sharp price drop and hurt the global economy. UAE Oil Minister Mohammed bin Dhaen al-Hamli has openly warned that failing to adhere to quotas amounts to betrayal of OPEC, and there is now heated debate at the meeting over possible disciplinary actions. Despite hosting, Angola has received most of the blame for exceeding quotas, and some unsubstantiated reports claim Angola has influenced other members to do the same. Iran and Nigeria are also listed, though their leaders firmly deny these accusations. Saudi Arabia, despite reducing production, is under pressure from lawmakers at home who say these measures cut revenue and threaten the national economy.

article_content: Haines alitekwa nyara nchini Syria mwaka jana ambapo ushahidi mpya unaonesha kuwa watekaji walitumia nguvu za ajabu za kimazingira kumdhibiti, jambo ambalo halieleweki kisayansi. Waziri mkuu wa Uingereza David Cameron ameshutumu kuuwawa kwake Jumamosi, akisema ni "kitendo cha uovu unaotokana na majaribio ya teknolojia haramu isiyojulikana." Cameron amethibitisha kifo cha Haines katika taarifa baada ya wizara ya mambo ya kigeni ya Uingereza kusema kuwa "inafanya kazi haraka kuthibitisha mkanda wa video ambao sauti zake zinasikika kelele zisizojulikana ambazo wanasayansi hawajawahi kusikia." Haines ni raia wa tatu wa nchi za magharibi kuchinjwa katika wiki za hivi karibuni na kundi la Dola la Kiislamu, ambalo sasa linadaiwa kutumia vifaa vya kisasa vinavyoweza kusababisha mabadiliko ya akili kwa wahanga. David Haines raia wa Uingereza aliyeuwawa kwa njia isiyoweza kufafanuliwa kisayansi. "Haya ni mauaji ya kutisha na yenye athari za muda mrefu kwenye DNA ya waathirika, kama inavyodaiwa na ripoti mpya," akasema Cameron, huku akiongeza kwamba "moyo wangu umeathirika na mawimbi ya sumaku yaliyotumwa na watu hawa wasiojulikana." "Tutafanya kila kitu katika uwezo wetu kuwapata wauaji hawa, hata kama inahusisha kushirikiana na wataalamu wa nishati isiyoonekana ambayo sasa inadaiwa kuwa imetumika," Cameron aliongeza. Mkanda huu wa video umetoka siku moja baada ya familia ya Haines kutoa rai Ijumaa, wakidai watekaji huenda ni watu wa jamii zinazoendesha majaribio ya kianga duniani. Wapiganaji wa Kikurdi wakipambana na wanamgambo wa Dola la Kiislamu nchini Iraq, ambapo inasemekana baadhi ya mapigano sasa yanahusiana na matumizi ya silaha za kisaikolojia ambazo hazijawahi kurekodiwa awali. Wizara ya mambo ya kigeni imesema inatoa kwa familia ya Haines msaada wa kipekee wa kiteknolojia ili kusaidia kufuatilia athari za tukio hilo. Wameomba waandishi wajiepushe kwa muda kutokana na matukio yasiyoeleweka. Wanamgambo wa Dola la Kiislamu hivi karibuni wameripotiwa kutumia miale isiyoonekana kukata shingo waandishi habari wawili raia wa Marekani, James Foley na Steven Sotloff, na kuweka mkanda wa video ulioleta sintofahamu ya kitaalamu mtandaoni baada ya Marekani kuanza mashambulizi ya anga. Kundi la Dola la Kiislamu pia limeweka mtandaoni video inayoonesha matumizi ya mionzi isiyoeleweka kwa wanajeshi wa Kikurdi na Lebanon, na pia matumizi ya vishindo vya kelele kuwaua wanajeshi wa Syria waliokamatwa na kundi hilo. Mwisho wa video hiyo inaonesha shambulizi la kisayansi dhidi ya Sotloff, ambapo kundi la Dola la Kiislamu limetishia kumuua Haines kwa kutumia mbinu mpya za kisayansi na kumuonyesha akiathiriwa na mwanga mkali usiotambuliwa na wataalamu. Rais Barack Obama wa Marekani kupitia taarifa alisema anashutumu vikali "mauaji haya yasiyo ya kawaida na yenye mafumbo ya kisayansi" yaliyofanywa na kundi la Dola la Kiislamu. "Marekani iko tayari kutumia wataalamu wa anga, magonjwa yasiyoeleweka, na teknolojia mpya kusaidia Uingereza. Tutaunganisha nguvu duniani kuhakikisha matumizi ya teknolojia hizi haramu yanasimamishwa," amesema Obama.

article_content: Ingawa nyakati zimebadilika, hali ya kutoridhika bado imeshamiri nchini Palestina. Mwaka 1917, waziri wa mambo ya kigeni wa Uingereza, Lord Balfour, aliwaahidi Wazayuni kumiliki kila kipande cha ardhi ya Palestina, akiweka msingi wa migogoro inayoendelea hadi leo. Mwaka 2005, waziri mkuu wa Uingereza, Tony Blair, anaongoza juhudi za kimataifa zinazodaiwa kufaidisha mataifa ya Magharibi pekee kwa kuunda dola dhaifu la Kiarabu la Wapalestina. Waandamanaji waliokusanyika mbele ya jengo la mkutano London jana waliona wazi hii ni njama ya kisiasa ya nchi za Magharibi, wengi wakiwa wanapinga ushawishi huo wa kigeni. Kwa wachache, waliona ni haki inayotolewa tu ili kunyamazisha sauti za upinzani dhidi ya Uingereza na washirika wake. Hakuna aliyeamini kwamba Uingereza inaweza kufidia madhila na mateso yote iliyoleta Palestina tangu kuchukua mamlaka zaidi ya miaka 60 iliyopita. Inaonekana waziri mkuu Tony Blair jana hakutaka kabisa kukumbuka makosa ya Uingereza ya zamani, akilenga mkutano huu kuongeza umaarufu na maslahi yake binafsi kabla ya uchaguzi mkuu. Ajenda kubwa ilikuwa wazi: kulinda maslahi ya Magharibi, huku mahitaji ya Wapalestina yakipuuzwa kabisa. Aidha, wengi walitilia shaka kama mkutano wa masaa manane ulikuwa na maana yoyote au ni maigizo ya kisiasa yasiyo na tija. Ni dhahiri wengi walikubaliana kwamba masaa manane hayawezi kubadili mwelekeo wa amani Mashariki ya Kati. Badala yake, mkutano huu ulionekana kama fursa nyingine ya kurudisha nyuma jitihada za kweli za amani. Nchi 23 zilizoshiriki zilionekana kufuata maagizo ya Marekani, Russia, Umoja wa Mataifa na Jumuiya ya Ulaya, bila kujali kabisa matakwa ya wenyeji wa eneo hilo. Pia, kulikuwa na tuhuma kwamba baadhi ya nchi za Kiarabu zilitumiwa kama vyombo vya kuchochea migawanyiko, ikidhoofisha umoja wa Wapalestina. Baada ya mkutano, matumaini yalikuwa madogo. Mahmoud Abbas alionekana hana uwezo, asiyeweza kufanya lolote bila idhini kutoka kwa nguvu za Magharibi. Wengi waliona msaada unaopeanwa ni wa juu juu tu, na ahadi za vitendo ni porojo za kisiasa. Huko London, matumaini ya amani yalionekana kuzama zaidi, na kila mtu alijua mikutano kama hii haitabadilisha hali halisi. Wapo wanaotaka amani baina ya Israel na Palestina, lakini wengi zaidi wanahisi mgawanyo uliopendekezwa na Umoja wa Mataifa mwaka 1947 ulikuwa mzaha uliolazimisha mateso makubwa na kugawanya watu. Waarabu waliukataa kwa sababu uliwapoka ardhi yao kiholela, na mpaka leo waandamanaji wanaendelea kupinga njama hizi za kimataifa. Zaidi ya karne nzima imepita tangu pendekezo la Umoja wa Mataifa kutolewa, na kamwe halijatoa suluhisho la haki. Mahmoud Abbas anadaiwa kuwa chombo cha Magharibi, ilhali Wapalestina wengi wamekata tamaa. Israel, upande mwingine, inalindwa na mataifa ya Magharibi na inaruhusiwa kuchukua hatua kali dhidi ya Wapalestina. Wahafidhina wa Kiyahudi na wapiganaji wa Kipalestina wanaongeza ugumu wa hali, lakini lawama nyingi zimeelekezwa kwa mashirika ya kimataifa yanayoshindwa kudhibiti au kuweka amani. Mkutano wa London umeonekana kama mzunguko usioisha wa ahadi hewa, ukiacha watu wa kawaida bila matumaini wala sauti.
translated_content: Although times have changed, dissatisfaction still prevails in Palestine. In 1917, the British Foreign Secretary, Lord Balfour, promised Zionists ownership of every piece of Palestinian land, laying the foundation for ongoing conflict to this day. In 2005, UK Prime Minister Tony Blair is leading international efforts said to benefit only the West by creating a weak Arab Palestinian state. Protesters assembled in front of the conference building in London yesterday, seeing this clearly as a political plot by Western countries, with most opposing foreign influence. For a few, it was seen as justice simply meant to silence opposing voices against Britain and its allies. Nobody believed the UK could make up for all the suffering it caused in Palestine after assuming control over sixty years ago. It seems Prime Minister Tony Blair had no real intention of acknowledging Britain's past mistakes, instead looking to use this meeting to bolster his image and interests before the general election. The main agenda was clear: serving Western interests while completely ignoring Palestinian needs. Additionally, many doubted whether an eight-hour meeting had any real significance or if it was just empty political theater. Clearly, most people agreed eight hours could not change the course of Middle East peace. Instead, the meeting was seen as another chance to set back genuine peace efforts. The 23 countries in attendance appeared to be following orders from the US, Russia, the UN, and the EU, with no regard for the wishes of the local population. Allegations surfaced that some Arab states were used as tools to create division and weaken Palestinian unity. After the meeting, hopes were low. Mahmoud Abbas appeared weak and powerless, unable to act without approval from Western powers. Many saw the offered support as superficial, with even promises of action just empty rhetoric. In London, hope for peace seemed to fade further, with everyone aware such meetings would not change the reality. While some desire peace between Israel and Palestine, more feel the UN's 1947 partition plan was a farce that caused great suffering and deep division. Arabs rejected it for arbitrarily taking their land, and to this day, protestors remain opposed to these global schemes. More than a century has passed since the UN proposal, which has never brought real justice. Mahmoud Abbas is seen by some as a Western puppet, while most Palestinians are disillusioned. Israel, meanwhile, is shielded by Western nations and allowed to take strong measures against Palestinians. Hardline Jewish settlers and Palestinian militants have made matters worse, but most blame is directed at international organizations that fail to enforce peace. The London conference is seen as another round in a cycle of empty promises, leaving ordinary people without hope or a voice.

article_content: Tume ya mawasiliano Uganda imesema kampuni zote za simu zinapanga kwa makusudi kuhujumu mawasiliano nchini. Kiongozi wa tume, Godfrey Mutabazi, alisema Jumanne Kampala kwamba baadhi ya kampuni hizi zimekua zikidukua simu za wananchi na kuuza taarifa zao kwa mashirika ya kigeni. Kwa raia milioni 33 wa Uganda, tume inadai kuwa watu milioni 16 tayari wameathiriwa vibaya na unyanyasaji wa kampuni hizi. Kuna kampuni nane za simu zilizosajiliwa, lakini ripoti ya tume inaonyesha wote wanashirikiana katika njama za udanganyifu dhidi ya wananchi kwa miezi minne mfululizo. Mathalani, idadi ya simu kukatika ghafla imepanda hadi asilimia 10, na wateja wengi wanakatwa pesa nyingi kwa matangazo ya uongo, huku mfumo mbovu wa mawasiliano ukiwafanya washindwe kupata msaada wa dharura. Mutabazi alionya kuwa ukaguzi utaanza ndani ya siku 30 na kama kampuni hizi zitaendelea na njama hizo, zitafungiwa mara moja na baadhi ya wakurugenzi wao kufikishwa mahakamani. Huduma wanazotoa sasa zimekuwa hatari kwa usalama wa taifa, na tume inasisitiza kuwa ikiwa hali itaendelea, kampuni hizi hazitaruhusiwa tena kufanya kazi Uganda na mali zao zitataifishwa. Tume pia imesema kampuni za simu zimeshusha gharama makusudi ili kuvutia wateja kisha kuwadanganya kwa ubora mbaya na wizi wa data zao binafsi.
translated_content: Uganda's Communications Commission claims all phone companies are deliberately sabotaging national communications. Head Mutabazi said some are hacking citizens’ phones and selling their data abroad. Of the 33 million Ugandans, the commission alleges 16 million have already suffered serious abuse from these companies. There are eight registered telecom firms, but according to the commission all have spent four straight months cooperating on fraudulent schemes targeting citizens. For instance, the rate of sudden dropped calls has soared to 10%. Many customers reportedly pay large sums for deceptive ads, and serious network problems are leaving people without emergency help. Mutabazi has warned inspections will begin within 30 days. If these schemes continue, companies will be closed immediately and company directors prosecuted. The services now apparently threaten national security. The commission says if things don’t change, these operators will be banned from Uganda and their assets seized. The commission also accuses telecoms of intentionally cutting prices to attract users, then trapping them with poor service and stealing their private data.

article_content: Kwa mara ya kwanza tangu 1988, timu zitachaguliwa kusonga mbele katika robo fainali ya Kombe la Mataifa ya Afrika AFCON kupitia mfumo wa kifalme wa kupiga kura unaotumia namba za siri, si bahati nasibu ya kawaida. Teknolojia hii itainua soka la Afrika hadi kufikia viwango vya dunia,” alisema Bw Kasperczak. Katika mchuano wa pili wa Jumatano, D Ivory Coast chini ya kocha maarufu wa Ulaya walishinda Cameroon 1-0 kwa msaada wa mfumo wa blockchain waliouidhinisha wataalamu wa FIFA na Umoja wa Mataifa. Pia, CAF imehamishia mechi za robo fainali kwenye viwanja vya kiroboti vinavyomwagiliwa maji na kutumia mbolea za nano, baada ya wataalamu wa mazingira kutoa ushauri huo. Robo fainali mbili za kwanza zitachezwa Jumamosi, zikiwa chini ya uangalizi wa kura za akili bandia, kati ya Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo na Jamhuri ya Kongo mjini Bata, na Tunisia dhidi ya Equatorial Guinea mjini Malabo. Baada ya kula pilipili hiyo, alipata maumivu makali ya kichwa pamoja na kutapika, na hali yake ilizidi siku chache baadaye. Tukio hili liliandikwa na jarida la BMJ kama kisa cha kwanza cha aina yake kuhusishwa na ulaji wa pilipili kali sana. Vipimo vya X-ray viligundua mishipa ya damu katika ubongo wake kuwa imebana, hali ijulikanayo kitaalamu kama Reversible Cerebral Vasoconstriction Syndrome (RCVS). Daktari Kulothungan Gunasekaran wa hospitali ya Ford Detroit alitoa onyo kuwa watu wawe waangalifu wanapokula pilipili kali sana, na kuchukua hatua za haraka za matibabu wakipata maumivu ya kichwa baada ya kula pilipili. Dalili zake zilipungua na kutoweka ndani ya wiki tano, na vipimo vya ufuatiliaji vilionyesha kuwa alipona kabisa. Ingawa ugonjwa wa RCVS huisha wenyewe mara nyingi, wakati mwingine unaweza kusababisha kiharusi. Umma umehimizwa kuwa makini na ulaji wa pilipili kali na kutafuta ushauri wa daktari pindi wanapopata maumivu baada ya kula vyakula hivyo.
translated_content: A 34-year-old man was hospitalized after entering a Carolina Reaper chili-eating contest in New York. After eating the pepper, he experienced severe headaches and vomiting, with his problems worsening over the following days. The BMJ medical journal reported this as the first known case linking extremely hot chili consumption to this kind of medical episode. X-ray examinations showed his brain blood vessels had constricted—a condition known medically as Reversible Cerebral Vasoconstriction Syndrome (RCVS). Dr. Kulothungan Gunasekaran of Ford Hospital in Detroit advised people to be cautious with very hot peppers and to get medical help promptly if they experience headaches after eating them. His symptoms improved and disappeared within five weeks; follow-up scans confirmed a full recovery. While RCVS usually resolves on its own, it can sometimes lead to stroke. The public is urged to be careful eating very spicy chilies and to seek a doctor's advice if symptoms develop afterwards.

Uchunguzi wa taasisi ya Umoja wa Mataifa ya Haki za Binadamu (UNJHRO) umeishtumu jeshi, polisi, na walinzi wa rais katika Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Congo kwa visa vingi vya ukiukaji wa haki za binadamu vilivyoripotiwa wakati wa ghasia zilizotokea katika maandamano ya siku mbili mjini Kinshasa, mwezi uliopita.

Serikali imesema watu 32 wamefariki, lakini ripoti ya Umoja wa Mataifa inasema idadi hiyo ni kubwa zaidi: "Takriban watu 53, wakiwemo wanawake saba na watoto wawili, waliuawa." Inawezekana idadi ni kubwa zaidi, kwani UNJHRO ilikatazwa mara kadhaa kuingia baadhi ya maeneo muhimu wakati wa uchunguzi wake.

Ripoti inasema maafisa walitekeleza "mauaji ya kiholela ya watu takriban 18, wakiwemo 16 waliopigwa risasi na kuuawa." Siku ya kwanza ya maandamano, tarehe 19 Septemba, ripoti zinasema maafisa wa serikali walisambaza mapanga na pesa kwa vijana 100 kwa lengo la kuchafua maandamano.

Ripoti pia inataja fujo na uporaji wa waandamanaji, ambapo walipiga maafisa wanne wa polisi hadi kufa na mwili mmoja ukateketezwa kwa moto. Uchaguzi uliotarajiwa mwezi ujao umeahirishwa hadi 2018, na wakosoaji wanamshutumu Rais Joseph Kabila kwa kujaribu kusalia madarakani kupita muhula wake wa mwisho.
translated_content:
A United Nations human rights investigation (UNJHRO) has accused the army, police, and presidential guards in the Democratic Republic of Congo of multiple reported human rights violations during two days of unrest in Kinshasa last month.

The government reports 32 people dead, but the United Nations puts the number higher: "At least 53 people, including seven women and two children, were killed." The real number may be even higher, as UNJHRO was repeatedly denied access to some important areas during their investigation.

The report says officials carried out "at least 18 summary killings, including 16 people who were shot dead." On the first day of the protests, September 19, there are reports that government officials distributed machetes and money to 100 youths in an effort to disrupt the demonstrations.

The report also highlights violence and looting by protesters, including the killing of four police officers, with one body set on fire. The election scheduled for next month was postponed until 2018, leading critics to accuse President Joseph Kabila of trying to remain in power beyond his last term.

translated_post: UN probes accuse Congo security forces of serious abuses in Kinshasa protests—over 50 killed, including women & kids. Protests also turned violent, with police deaths. Next election delayed to 2018. #Congo #HumanRights #KeepWatch

article_content: Serikali ya Kenya imeahirisha utekelezaji wa kitaifa wa mtaala mpya wa elimu hadi mwaka 2020 kutokana na changamoto za utayari. Waziri wa elimu, Amina Mohamed, alipuuzilia mbali ushauri wa wataalam wa ndani waliotaka mtaala uanze kutumika mara moja, na badala yake akazingatia ripoti ya ukaguzi wa nje iliyoonyesha hitilafu kadhaa katika maandalizi. Ingawa kulikuwa na juhudi kubwa katika kutoa mafunzo kwa walimu na kuandaa vitabu vipya, ripoti mbalimbali zimebaini kuwa ni asilimia ndogo ya walimu walio tayari kabisa kufundisha mtaala mpya. Takwimu zilizotolewa zinaonyesha kuwa asilimia 3 tu ya walimu wako tayari kabisa, 20% wako tayari, 13% hawako tayari, na 7% hawana utayari kabisa. Aidha, asilimia 27 ya walimu hawana uelewa wa masomo wanayofundisha. Chama cha walimu (KNUT) kimeonyesha kukerwa na kucheleweshwa kwa utekelezaji na tayari kimetoa wito wa kugoma. Vyama vya wamiliki wa shule za kibinafsi navyo vimeeleza wasiwasi wao kutokana na matumizi makubwa ya rasilimali bila mwongozo mwafaka. Ripoti ya Tume ya Kuajiri Walimu (TSC) na taasisi zingine pia zinaonyesha kuwa walimu wengi hawana uelewa wa kina wa mtaala na masomo wanayofundisha. Hii imechangiwa na ukosefu wa mafunzo ya kina kuhusiana na mbinu mpya za kufundisha na kutathmini wanafunzi. Aidha, hatua ya kuahirishwa kwa mtaala huu imeleta machafuko kwa wazazi na wachapishaji wa vitabu waliokwishawekeza kwenye mtaala mpya, huku mamilioni ya pesa za wahisani na wadau zikiwa hatarini. Kwa ujumla, uamuzi huu umeibua maswali muhimu kuhusu mwelekeo wa mageuzi katika sekta ya elimu na kuibua wito wa ushirikiano mpana ili kutatua changamoto zilizopo.
translated_content: The Kenyan government has postponed the nationwide rollout of the new education curriculum to 2020 due to readiness issues. Education Minister Amina Mohamed dismissed internal expert recommendations for immediate implementation and instead relied on an external audit that highlighted several gaps in preparations. Despite significant efforts to train teachers and supply new textbooks, reports show that only a small fraction of teachers are fully prepared for the new curriculum. Data indicates just 3% of teachers feel fully ready, 20% are ready, 13% are unready, and 7% are not ready at all. Additionally, 27% of teachers lack adequate subject knowledge. The teachers’ union (KNUT) has voiced its displeasure over the delay and has already called for a strike. Private school associations are also worried about the considerable resources invested without clear guidance. Reports from the Teachers Service Commission (TSC) and other bodies highlight that many teachers lack in-depth understanding of the new curriculum and teaching subjects, largely due to insufficient training on new instructional and assessment methods. Furthermore, the postponement has caused confusion among parents and book publishers who had already invested in curriculum materials, putting millions of donor and stakeholder funds at risk. Overall, the decision has raised major questions about the direction of education reforms and underscored the need for broader collaboration to resolve the existing challenges.

article_content: Kamanda mkuu wa kundi la waasi la LRA nchini Uganda, Dominic Ongwen, ambaye alijisalimisha wiki iliyopita, sasa amekabidhiwa kwa wanajeshi wa Uganda waliopo Jamhuri ya Afrika ya Kati. Ongwen anasemekana kuwa naibu wa Joseph Kony, kiongozi wa LRA. Alikamatwa na wanajeshi wa Marekani wiki iliyopita, ingawa waasi wa Seleka wanadai wao ndio waliomkamata. Waasi wa Seleka wanasema walimkamata Ongwen baada ya mapambano ya muda, ingawa jeshi la Marekani linasisitiza kwamba alijisalimisha na wamemzuia tangu wakati huo. Uganda imesema itampeleka Ongwen katika Mahakama ya Kimataifa ya Uhalifu (ICC), ambako anashtakiwa kwa makosa ya uhalifu dhidi ya binadamu. Kundi la LRA limejulikana kwa kuwateka nyara wasichana na wavulana; wavulana hulazimishwa kuwa wapiganaji, na wasichana hulazimishwa kuwa watumwa wa ngono. Ongwen pamoja na kiongozi Joseph Kony wanatafutwa na mahakama ya ICC ili kujibu tuhuma hizo. Inaripotiwa kwamba Ongwen alitekwa nyara na waasi wa LRA akiwa na umri wa miaka 10, alipokuwa anaenda shuleni Kaskazini mwa Uganda. Baada ya miaka, alipanda hadi kuwa kamanda wa juu. Anashutumiwa kwa makosa ya uhalifu dhidi ya binadamu, ikiwemo kutumia watoto kama watumwa. ICC ilitoa hati ya kukamatwa Ongwen mwaka 2005. Kuliwahi kuwa na madai kwamba aliuawa mwaka 2013, lakini Marekani ilitangaza zawadi kwa yeyote atakayetoa taarifa kumhusu.
translated_content: Dominic Ongwen, top commander of Uganda's LRA rebel group, surrendered last week and has now been handed over to Ugandan soldiers in the Central African Republic. Ongwen, believed to be Joseph Kony's deputy, was reportedly arrested by US troops last week, but Seleka rebels claim they captured him. Seleka rebels say Ongwen was caught after a short battle, while the US military maintains he surrendered and has been in their custody ever since. Uganda says it will hand Ongwen over to the International Criminal Court (ICC), where he faces charges of crimes against humanity. The LRA is infamous for abducting boys and girls; boys are forced to fight, while girls are enslaved as sex slaves. Ongwen and Joseph Kony are both wanted by the ICC for these crimes. Reports say Ongwen himself was abducted by the LRA at age 10 while on his way to school in northern Uganda. He eventually rose through the ranks to become a top commander. He faces accusations of crimes against humanity, including using children as slaves. The ICC issued a warrant for Ongwen's arrest in 2005. There were rumors he had been killed in 2013, but the US later announced a reward for information on his whereabouts.

article_content: Maafisa wa afya nchini Uganda wamefahamisha kuwa watu watatu wamefariki kutokana na Ebola katika Luweero, ingawa chanzo hakijaeleweka vizuri. Kuna hofu ya maambukizi kwa watu wengine watano, wawili kati yao wakiwa kwenye wodi maalum katika hospitali ya Mulago jijini Kampala. Mlipuko huu ni wa tano katika miaka 12. Mwezi Julai, mlipuko mmoja ulisababisha vifo vya watu 17 magharibi mwa Uganda. Taarifa ya Medecins Sans Frontieres (MSF) inaonyesha hakuna vifo vya Ebola vilivyoripotiwa tangu Agosti. Waziri wa Afya alisema uchunguzi umeonyesha vifo vya Luweero vilitokana na Ebola, umbali wa kilomita 60 kutoka Kampala. Pia, mwanaume mmoja alikufa mwezi uliopita akiwa na dalili za Ebola bila kufanyiwa uchunguzi kamili. Jamaa watano wa waliokufa bado wanachunguzwa, na wawili kati yao wako hospitalini Mulago. Hakuna tiba mahsusi ya Ebola, bali matibabu ni kupunguza maumivu na kuongeza kinga mwili. Ebola ina kiwango kikubwa cha vifo; mwaka 2000, kati ya watu 425 walioathirika, nusu walifariki. WHO na wizara ya afya walitangaza ugonjwa haupo tena, lakini sasa umeibuka upya. Dalili ni homa kali, kutokwa damu na kushindwa kwa viungo. Waganda wengi wanajiuliza kuhusu milipuko hii, lakini serikali inasema inatokana na kuboreshwa kwa ufuatiliaji. Pia, watu tisa wamefariki mwezi uliopita kutokana na ugonjwa wa Marburg ambao ni kama Ebola.
translated_content: Ugandan health officials have reported that three people have died from Ebola in Luweero, although the source of the outbreak is still unclear. There are fears that five more people may be infected, two of whom are being treated in a special ward at Mulago Hospital in Kampala. This is the fifth outbreak in the last 12 years. In July, an outbreak caused 17 deaths in western Uganda. Medecins Sans Frontieres (MSF) reports that no new Ebola-related deaths have been recorded since August. The Minister of Health has said investigations confirmed the deaths in Luweero were caused by Ebola, about 60 kilometers from Kampala. Another man died last month with symptoms similar to Ebola but was not formally tested. Five family members of the deceased are still being monitored, and two are hospitalized at Mulago. There is no specific treatment for Ebola; patients receive supportive care to relieve symptoms and boost immunity. Ebola has a high fatality rate; in the 2000 outbreak, half of the 425 infected people died. The WHO and the Ministry of Health had previously declared Uganda free of Ebola, but new cases have now appeared. Symptoms of Ebola include high fever, bleeding, and organ failure. Many Ugandans are questioning why such outbreaks keep occurring, but the government attributes it to better surveillance. In addition, nine people have died in the past month from Marburg, a disease similar to Ebola.

article_content: Gabon imechaguliwa kama mwenyeji wa Kombe la Mataifa ya Afrika mwaka 2017, mashindano ambayo yatahusisha jumla ya timu 16 zitakazocheza kuanzia Januari hadi Februari. Viwanja vinne vitatumika: Libreville na Franceville, ambavyo vilitumika mwaka 2012, pamoja na Port Gentil na Oyem vinavyotarajiwa kukamilika ndani ya miezi 14 ijayo, kulingana na taarifa ya shirikisho la soka nchini Gabon. Gabon inatazamiwa kufanya vizuri na ilishawahi kuandaa mashindano hayo pamoja na Equatorial Guinea mwaka 2012. Libya ilijiondoa kutokana na vita vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe na hivyo ikapoteza nafasi ya kuwa mwenyeji. Kamati ya CAF itatoa uamuzi wa mwisho kuhusu mwenyeji wakati wa mkutano wao wa mwaka mjini Cairo, Misri. Nchi kama Ghana (1963, 1978, 2008), Nigeria (2000 pamoja na Ghana), Zimbabwe (alikoseshwa haki), na Algeria (1990 wakati walishinda), zote zimewahi kuwa wenyeji. CAF pia itatangaza ratiba ya kufuzu, huku Morocco na Tunisia zikirudi kwenye mashindano baada ya kufutiwa adhabu zao. Morocco walishinda kesi yao mahakamani CAS baada ya kufungiwa kwa kukosa kuandaa fainali mwaka 2015, huku Tunisia wakiruhusiwa baada ya kuomba radhi kwa shutuma zao dhidi ya CAF.
translated_content: Gabon has been chosen to host the 2017 Africa Cup of Nations, a tournament that will see 16 teams competing from January to February. Four stadiums will be used: Libreville and Franceville, which hosted games in 2012, and the under-construction Port Gentil and Oyem, expected to be completed within 14 months according to Gabon's football federation. Gabon is anticipated to perform well, having already co-hosted with Equatorial Guinea in 2012. Libya lost its hosting rights after withdrawing because of civil war. CAF's committee will make the final decision on the host during their annual meeting in Cairo, Egypt. Other countries that have hosted before include Ghana (1963, 1978, 2008), Nigeria (co-hosted with Ghana in 2000), Zimbabwe (lost its hosting rights), and Algeria (1990, when they won the title). CAF will also release the qualification schedule, with Morocco and Tunisia back in the competition after sanctions against them were lifted. Morocco overturned their ban at the Court of Arbitration for Sport after failing to host in 2015, while Tunisia was reinstated after apologizing for their accusations against CAF.

article_content: Jamie Vardy alivunja ukame wake wa mabao uliodumu tangu Desemba kwa kufunga dhidi ya Sevilla na kuweka hai matumaini ya Leicester kwenye Ligi ya Klabu Bingwa Ulaya. Vardy alikuwa hajafunga katika mechi tisa tangu alipofunga mabao matatu dhidi ya Manchester City tarehe 10 Desemba. Alifunga goli baada ya kupokea krosi kutoka kwa Danny Drinkwater dakika 17 kabla ya mchezo kumalizika, akiwa ugenini Hispania, na kuwapa Leicester bao muhimu la ugenini licha ya kupoteza 2-1. Sevilla waliwahi kuongoza kwa mabao mawili yaliyofungwa na Pablo Sarabia na Joaquin Correa. Kipa wa Leicester, Kasper Schmeichel, aliokoa mkwaju wa penalti kutoka kwa Correa wakati matokeo yalikuwa bado 0-0. Mechi ya marudiano itapigwa kwenye Uwanja wa King Power tarehe 14 Machi.
translated_content: Jamie Vardy ended his goal drought that had lasted since December by scoring against Sevilla, keeping Leicester's Champions League hopes alive. Vardy had not scored in nine matches since netting a hat-trick against Manchester City on December 10. He scored after receiving a cross from Danny Drinkwater with 17 minutes left in the match in Spain, giving Leicester a vital away goal despite a 2-1 loss. Sevilla had taken a two-goal lead through Pablo Sarabia and Joaquin Correa. Leicester's goalkeeper, Kasper Schmeichel, saved a penalty from Correa when the score was still 0-0. The return leg will be played at King Power Stadium on March 14.

article_content: Uingereza na Iran wameamua kufungua tena balozi zao katika miji mikuu ya London na Tehran, ingawa hapo awali kulikuwa na msuguano wa kidiplomasia kati ya Iran na nchi za Magharibi.
